Project-authored fictional draw-failure policy V1. Not Magic CR or Oracle evidence.
Reuse fictional turn windows V2 and its bounded card/payment procedures.
A native automatic turn draw removes the explicit index-zero library object if present.
Drawing the last card succeeds. An empty library alone never causes a loss.
An attempted automatic draw on an empty library creates no object and records the active player in failed_draw_players.
Complete draw progress exactly once. Queue the existing state-based checkpoint; grant no priority before it.
At the checkpoint, all players with life at/below the configured threshold or a recorded failed draw lose simultaneously.
The other players win; if all lose there are no winners. End the game, retain the failure record, clear pending procedures and grant no priority.
Unknown life, unsupported effects and restrictions still fail closed. No general draw effect or replacement semantics exist.
